title: Continuous Horizon Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2611.13228v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-horizon forecasting has been dominated by discrete forecast strategies that treat model outputs as fixed-vectors or recurrently create them. In this paper, we introduce the Continuous Horizon (CH) strategy that generalizes upon recursive, direct, and multi-step strategies by redefining forecasts as a continuous operator and the forecast horizon as a query variable rather than an index. We present the theoretical foundations for the CH strategy, a Universal Operator Approximation Theorem, and a continuous-horizon bias-variance decomposition that formally proves the estimation variance improvements of CH over the discrete strategies. We validate the CH strategy empirically through a simulation study, and on 16 large-scale datasets from the M-series benchmark, showing how CH achieves competitive RMSE accuracy, while uniquely enabling parallel inference, targeted horizon querying, and interpolation and extrapolation across unseen hor

translated_abstract: 多视界预测一直由离散预测策略主导，这些策略将模型输出视为固定向量或通过循环方式生成。在本文中，我们引入了连续视界（Continuous Horizon, CH）策略，它通过将预测重新定义为连续算子，并将预测视界定义为查询变量而非索引，从而对递归、直接和多步策略进行了泛化。我们为CH策略提供了理论基础，包括一个通用算子逼近定理，以及连续视界的偏差-方差分解，该分解从形式上证明了CH相对于离散策略在估计方差上的改进。我们通过仿真研究以及在M系列基准的16个大规模数据集上对CH策略进行了实证验证，结果表明CH实现了有竞争力的RMSE精度，同时独特地支持并行推理、针对性视界查询，以及对未见视界的插值和外推。
tldr: 本文提出连续视界（CH）预测策略，将预测重新定义为连续算子、把预测视界作为查询变量而非索引，在理论上证明了其相对于离散策略的估计方差优势，并通过大规模实验验证了其具有竞争力的精度，同时独特地支持并行推理和对未见视界的插值与外推。
